repository.name: agid-postal-kp
repository.purpose: KP-only evidence and promotion contract; no separate repository created

postal_system.reference_scope: The captured UPU PDF has an Aug. 2026 required-code table, but KP appears in a separate Sep. 2025 not-required table on physical page 4. This does not prove the permanent absence of every internal postal identifier or establish current delivery coverage. File last-modified time does not update the table edition.
postal_system.identity_rule: KP and KR remain separate registered identities. Neither KR's five-digit system nor a legacy three-plus-three pattern is evidence for KP. Existing administrative identifiers, first-order P0 seeds, planning cells and virtual codes are not official postcode assignments or postal boundaries.
postal_system.geometry_rule: Until exact competent-authority postal geometry is verified, official postal geometry is none. Separately licensed administrative/locality geometry must retain that role. Derived candidate surfaces and virtual AGID regions remain derived/virtual, with method, uncertainty and input versions; they do not create official coverage.
postal_system.address_rule: Postal or administrative containment never supplies a house number, building, floor, unit or recipient. Display those only from separately permitted explicit civic-address/building relations with stable identities, provenance, validity and privacy review. Missing relationships remain unavailable, not inferred.
postal_system.rights_rule: UPU public references and membership do not grant a reusable national data release. Exact resource terms, permission scope, attribution and version/digest must be reviewed independently. No contract, account, paid service or public destination is authorized by this contract.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID is an independent spatial index. Any future administrative, derived, virtual, postal, address or building object needs a typed versioned crosswalk. Keep postal_code nullable; do not invent a code to satisfy the API. KP is not enabled in the production Postal Context country policy by this review.

stages.definition: Verify the current KP postal framework and explicitly scoped, rights-cleared administrative/locality context with independently licensed real point/area geometry, stable identities, native names, hierarchy, validity, retrieval time, source edition and SHA-256. Preserve nullable postal_code and none for unverified official postal geometry; derived/virtual objects keep their distinct roles. Require reproducible transformation, complete validation of the declared release scope, CRS/topology and identity crosswalk checks, and explicit civic-address/building-link availability and privacy/licence review. Publish approved immutable data artifacts outside AGID Git and verify their hashes plus the actual AGID loader/API. Dated UPU tables, P0 seeds, planning cells and synthetic tests cannot substitute for these gates; no house or building may be inferred.
